summary: 114 pairs judged: KEEP-A 36, KEEP-B 35, MERGE 41, BOTH 2. The pattern: in most pairs only one body states the relation and the other side's link is unsaid, so the keep follows the page that says it; the better label is often the other page's label, or a phrase lifted from the stating page's own sentence (MERGE). Many W3 pairs carry a direction error on one side: Shop exemplifies Kokoro/Manim, Dub Lineage deepens Semantic Delay, Boundary-Crossing spawned Frequency-Time Duality, Harvest spawned Deposit, Stoicism/Confucianism spawned The Fortress and the Threshold (co-born, not spawned), Hand-Drawn enables Figure Rig, Action Potential Oscillator deepens Neural Granular, Kuramoto spawned Neural Granular against its own § Origin. Only two BOTHs: a stated lineage reciprocal (Generative Sample → Wavetable Libraries) and a lineage plus a live dependency (Diversity of Thought / The Shop). Pairs (0-based positions in fold-judgment-2.json) where neither body names the other, kept on frontmatter or Context alone and owed a sentence or a cut: 0, 11, 14, 23, 31, 41, 59, 66, 106. Retypes suggested in reasons, not applied: 13 (connects-to), 28/72 (exemplifies), 37 (member-of), 49 (exemplifies), 61/62 (connects-to or member-of), 69 (emerged-from if the origin is this project). Phase Reduction (9, 10) asks in its own text that both hubs link to it, which this one-per-pair fold overrides — the page sentence needs a touch if the fold lands.
